notes.title: 📢 Dev Log Preview | Upcoming Update
notes.content:
Before this Saturday, I’ll be releasing Version 1.31 with several important improvements:

🔧 Optimizations & Adjustments

Wave progression & balancing updates

Further increased game difficulty

Spore attributes nerfed for better balance

Expanded Relic attributes for more build variety



Next week, I’ll be reworking the skill & attribute selection system after each wave, bringing a clearer progression flow and more strategic choices. Here’s the new core loop:

🎮 New Flow 1️⃣ Start Game → Card Pool resets (limited size, generated by weight) 2️⃣ End of a run → 3 random cards appear, pick 1 3️⃣ Choose a skill → Skill card is added to the pool (repeat until skill limit is reached) 4️⃣ End of a wave → Draw cards from your deck to gain growth 5️⃣ Continue the battle...

✨ With this change, every build will feel more unique, and each choice will carry more weight!

Stay tuned for the upcoming test version — I’ll release it as soon as it’s ready.

notes.title: Demo Version 1.3 Pre – Update Notes
notes.content:
Relics of quality level 3 are now available. The background colors of previous quality 1 and 2 relics have been changed to base color and green (existing relic attributes remain unchanged; only the background color has been updated). Quality 3 relics have a blue background. Existing relic icons have been replaced.

In this demo, the maximum relic quality is 3 (blue). More relic types of qualities 1, 2, and 3, as well as special attributes, will be added in future updates.

Endless mode difficulty has been further increased.

Version 1.3 will be released later on Friday. During the weekend, additional character attributes will be added to make the relic system more diverse.

Various basic optimizations.

notes.title: 1.3pre Version Update
notes.content:
1. Added the initial version of the Relic System. Relics will randomly drop during waves, with Quality Level 2 relics dropping randomly after wave 200.

   Currently, there are only two qualities with limited attributes available. In the next couple of days, I will expand the system by adding more qualities and attributes. Over the coming week, I will continue updating and improving the Relic System.

2. Fixed an issue in the previous version where the maximum item limit did not work, allowing players to reach extremely high waves.

3. Changed boss drops to provide one attribute selection per drop.

4. Enabled the 1.3pre version leaderboard.

5. Various optimizations.

**Note:** If your save file encounters issues after updating to the new version, please check the `bug-list` channel in the game’s Discord for instructions on how to roll back your save.

If the game still cannot start or displays incorrectly, please leave a message in the Discord or on Steam. Thank you very much!

notes.title: Demo Update Patch Notes
notes.content:
Demo Version 1.1.3 Update Notes

Increased overall game difficulty – Endless wave enemies now have more HP

(More enemy types and wave optimizations coming this weekend)

Added a new attribute to the protagonist: “Attribute”, which increases base skill damage

(Currently a rare drop)

Character stats can now be viewed from the main menu

Fixed Korean text display issues

Fixed issue where +2 HP from planets was not applied correctly

Receive an Enhancer every 100 waves (temporary setup)

Demo Version 1.1.1 Update Notes

Minor optimizations and improvements

Fixed the issue where Story Complete and Max Pulse achievements could not be completed

Added a "Replay Story" button to the main menu

(Players who missed the Story Complete achievement can now click the story button on the main menu and skip the story to unlock it)

Added “Enhancer” to the story mode character

Fixed an issue where skipping the cutscene during the first boss encounter would cause the sound effect to persist

Demo Version 1.1.1 Update Notes

Added Korean language support

Fixed text encoding issues in the leaderboard

Minor optimizations and improvements

Demo Version 1.1 Update Notes

Added Enhancer (XX Gland)

Adjusted game difficulty and introduced Endless Mode

Fixed cumulative damage leaderboard and added new leaderboards for the latest version

Optimized various gameplay experiences
